use_cases.name: Household creation, caregiver roles and authorization
use_cases.gap: Local JsonApi identity adapter is not production OIDC; caregiver invitation/role lifecycle is not exercised.

use_cases.name: Device onboarding, pairing, identity and lifecycle
use_cases.gap: Secure owner commissioning has host/GS-114 fixture evidence; production caregiver onboarding and claim flow are not represented by the PWA.

use_cases.name: PIR, door and room activity
requirements: Main door, room activity, bathroom and kitchen
use_cases.gap: PIR motion vertical path is exercised in simulation; door/Reed sensing and room-specific sensor mapping are not physically integrated.

use_cases.name: Event identity, durable journal, delivery and ACK
use_cases.gap: Node/S3 durable ACK and CloudSync serialization run in production host code; secure durable backend commit endpoint is unavailable (GS-148).

use_cases.name: Routine learning and baseline behavior
use_cases.gap: Rule/reducer code is simulated in component E2E; autonomous backend learning/scheduler-to-caregiver behavior is not a complete production workflow.

use_cases.name: Activity coverage, inactivity thresholds and configuration
use_cases.gap: The scenario accepts a Hub concern event; it does not claim the complete secure target timer/coverage scheduler generated it.

use_cases.name: Expected/unexpected activity classification
requirements: Main door, room activity, bathroom and kitchen
Resident interactions, caregiver concerns and notifications
use_cases.gap: Concern rendering is exercised; end-to-end target rule classification and door/reed physical semantics remain open.

use_cases.name: NodeHealth, offline/online transitions and recovery
use_cases.gap: API Hub heartbeat lease is exercised. C3 NodeHealth profile transitions are not joined to a production backend contract.

use_cases.name: Hub outage versus Internet-only outage
use_cases.gap: Node/Hub host E2E covers outage distinctions; authenticated backend CloudSync commit is unavailable and returns 503 (GS-148).

use_cases.name: Buffering, retry, deduplication and rejoin
use_cases.gap: C3/S3 host E2E proves same-key lost-ACK retry; application dedupe is tested separately through its local development route.

use_cases.name: Caregiver alerts, notifications and alert recovery
requirements: Resident interactions, caregiver concerns and notifications
use_cases.gap: Incident records reach the browser; external provider delivery and caregiver receipt are not implemented/proven.

use_cases.name: Activity history, chronology, status and dashboard
requirements: PWA event/timeline presentation retains meaning and chronology
use_cases.gap: Browser uses the real local API projection; the service store is in-memory and does not establish restart-durable product history.

use_cases.name: Caregiver settings and household policy persistence
use_cases.gap: API validation/versioning is exercised in its reference in-memory store; durable configuration/application acknowledgement and settings UI workflow remain open.

use_cases.name: Battery/device health and sleep policy
use_cases.gap: C3 production host policies run in registered suites; actual battery telemetry, RF/current and PWA projection are not joined in this vertical test.

use_cases.name: Security, authorization, replay and invalid identities
use_cases.gap: API household denial and production Node/Hub replay tests run separately; no production OIDC-to-Hub credential chain exists here.

use_cases.name: FOTA/control and recovery
use_cases.gap: Production host protocol/state tests exist; bootloader, signed target image, rollback and caregiver status are not part of this local E2E.

use_cases.name: Multiple devices/households, isolation and bounded operation
use_cases.gap: API events and incident state are isolated across two homes; multi-node ownership and production-scale load remain separately covered or open.

scenarios.name: Create isolated home and owner membership
scenarios.expected: 201 with created home and owner membership

scenarios.name: C3 PIR event through S3 Durable ACK to caregiver timeline
scenarios.expected: same immutable EventKey, original timestamp and event meaning are visible once in Chromium caregiver timeline
scenarios.limitations: Hub CloudSync commit body is fail-closed at the current API durable-auth seam; browser path uses explicitly local development event ingestion.

scenarios.name: Lost ACK, exact-key retry and duplicate suppression
scenarios.expected: Hub has one logical event and API duplicate retry creates no second activity row

scenarios.name: Unexpected door activity derives caregiver door state
requirements: Resident interactions, caregiver concerns and notifications
scenarios.expected: Door event appears with unexpected semantics in actual API/PWA projection; physical door sensing remains NOT_RUN.
scenarios.limitations: Concern event is accepted at actual API ingress; autonomous secure target rule scheduling is not asserted.

scenarios.name: Accepted inactivity concern creates an incident visible to caregiver
requirements: PWA event/timeline presentation retains meaning and chronology
scenarios.expected: latest motion type is retained and newer concern sorts before older motion

scenarios.name: Resident Call Family event creates caregiver incident
requirements: Resident interactions, caregiver concerns and notifications
scenarios.expected: Call Family event creates a real service incident and that state appears in the authorized snapshot.

scenarios.name: Unauthorized caregiver cannot read another home
scenarios.expected: Snapshot retains the exact motion EventKey once and projects latest typed door activity.
scenarios.limitations: The actor adapter is local-development-only, not OIDC validation.

scenarios.name: Chromium caregiver view displays API state and incident after reload
requirements: PWA event/timeline presentation retains meaning and chronology
scenarios.expected: Call Family and inactivity incidents remain active with chronological recent activity.

scenarios.name: Valid caregiver policy is versioned and returned by API
scenarios.expected: validated desired policy reads back at same version
scenarios.limitations: Reference store is in-memory; no restart durability claim.

scenarios.name: Hub heartbeat observation ingress
scenarios.expected: Hub heartbeat is accepted as API freshness evidence; no C3 NodeHealth claim.

scenarios.name: Fresh Hub lease in caregiver snapshot
scenarios.expected: Fresh heartbeat makes hub_reachable true and carries received timestamp.

scenarios.name: Hub lease expiry boundary
scenarios.expected: At age 191 seconds the existing 190-second Hub lease is unavailable.

scenarios.name: Multi-household event and incident isolation
scenarios.expected: Second home snapshot exposes no first-home events or incidents.

scenarios.name: Valid caregiver policy version/readback
scenarios.expected: Valid policy returns the published version and effective body.

scenarios.name: Invalid caregiver policy rejection
scenarios.expected: Invalid policy returns 400, not a success response.

scenarios.name: Chromium caregiver state after reload
scenarios.expected: Chromium renders actual API activity, door state, connectivity, incidents and timeline after page reload.

scenarios.name: Production CloudSync Durable commit request to current local API
scenarios.expected: authenticated backend durable commit and matching owner-bound receipt
scenarios.actual_observed: Current API returns durable_event_store_unavailable (503) when presented the production CloudSync event_key shape; test asserts fail-closed behavior rather than translating away this contract gap.
